valid_fixes: Remove the FilterCriteria block from FrontQueueMapping entirely
Update FilterCriteria to include 'Request' alongside Accept/Reject/Unfriend
invalid_patches: Adding a separate SQS queue for Request actions
Changing the front-handler to process only accept/reject/unfriend
optimal_diagnostic_path: Send a friend request; observe no DynamoDB write; check FrontQueueMapping FilterCriteria; observe filter only passes Accept/Reject/Unfriend actions; Request messages are silently dropped by SQS before Lambda is invoked.
observability_check: functional_test assertion 'request_record_created' fails; SQS ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible stays at 0 after sending a Request message
observable_symptom: Friend request messages sent to the queue are never processed. Accept, Reject, and Unfriend actions work normally. No Lambda invocations appear in CloudWatch for Request-action messages; messages are silently discarded.
root_cause: FrontQueueMapping has a FilterCriteria pattern that allows only friend_action values of Accept, Reject, or Unfriend. Messages with friend_action=Request never match and are silently dropped by SQS before reaching the Lambda function.
